sections.title: Take
sections.description: Pick a scene, frame it with the Photo Mode camera, start your recorder and roll. F8 rolls, F9 stops, F10 cycles the frame guide.

controls.label: Status
controls.description: What CINE is doing now.

controls.label: Scene
controls.description: The camera recipe for the take. Scenes come from the CINE packs installed in the game.

controls.label: About
controls.description: The scene's own description.

controls.label: Roll Take
controls.description: Starts the scene after the countdown. Same as F8 or D-pad up while the camera has focus.

controls.label: Countdown
controls.description: Seconds between rolling and action, to start your recorder. The countdown is shown small in a corner; trim it from the video.

controls.label: Distance
controls.description: Moves every camera closer or further.

controls.label: Height
controls.description: Raises or lowers every camera and its aim together.

controls.label: Field of View
controls.description: Wider or tighter lens. Portrait (9:16) recordings usually want about 1.25x.

controls.label: Frame Guide
controls.description: Darkens everything outside the chosen frame while you set up. Hidden during takes, so it never ends up in a recording. Breakdown labels, the caption and the signature stay inside the chosen frame.

controls.label: Ease In at Walls
controls.description: Checks the camera path before the take and moves the camera closer where a wall would block it, instead of jumping to her other side.

controls.label: Picture
controls.description: The game draws shadows for play: coarse on a moving character, which shows as blocky shadow edges and dotted skin in a close-up. For the length of a take CINE raises the shadow quality, and with the last choice also renders at full resolution (heavier). The game's own values go back when the take ends. Until the game is restarted, the graphics options for shadows and resolution may not take effect after a take that raised them.

controls.label: Signature
controls.description: Shows your signature block at the bottom left of the frame during takes. The text is signature.txt in the CINE folder: the first line is the name, the lines under it are small print. Edit it to your own.

controls.label: Reload Scenes
controls.description: Reads the installed CINE packs and the presets folder again. A pack installed while the game runs needs a restart.

sections.title: Route
sections.description: Walk scenes follow a route you walk once, and end on a final shot you frame yourself.

controls.label: Route
controls.description: The saved route.

controls.label: Record Route
controls.description: Closes the menu. Walk the route, then stand still for 3 seconds. F9 cancels.

controls.label: Final Shot
controls.description: The saved last shot.

controls.label: Use Current View as Final Shot
controls.description: Saves this view, relative to her, as the walk's last shot. Frame it with the Photo Mode camera first. F7 does the same.

sections.title: Animation
sections.description: A dance, pose or expression for the take. Needs CSS Locomotion Shared Assets and a supported outfit.

controls.label: Animation
controls.description: Off keeps your selected locomotion. Performances keep their authored once, loop or held-pose behavior. F9 stops the take and restores locomotion.

controls.label: Animation Speed
controls.description: Changes only the selected animation's playback rate. Camera timing, audio and game speed stay as set.

controls.label: Start At
controls.description: Start at this point in the animation. A time beyond the selected clip is rejected before playback.

controls.label: Selected Animation
controls.description: Playback behavior or the reason the selected animation is unavailable.

controls.label: Refresh Animations
controls.description: Read the installed animation libraries and check the outfit you are wearing. Use this after changing outfits or installing a pack.

controls.label: Expression
controls.description: As set in CSS keeps your current face. Original face temporarily clears a selected expression. Other choices apply only for this take.

controls.label: Selected Expression
controls.description: Availability and restoration for the selected expression.

controls.label: Refresh Expressions
controls.description: Check the expressions available for the outfit you are wearing.

sections.title: Scene
sections.description: Clean scene and the VFX-style breakdown.

controls.label: Hide Characters
controls.description: Hidden characters are frozen, cannot be hit and cannot hurt you, and new ones do not spawn while this is on. Bosses are left alone. With nobody kept you also cannot be hurt or noticed while it is on.

controls.label: Keep Lock-On Target
controls.description: Leaves the enemy you are locked on to in the scene, so you can film a fight with just that one. The fight is real: it can see you and hurt you.

controls.label: Now
controls.description: What clean scene is doing.

controls.label: Breakdown
controls.description: Built-in reel: runs through every layer over the length of the take and ends on the final image. From the preset: breakdown steps written in the preset file.

controls.label: Labels and Arrows
controls.description: Names what each layer shows, with an arrow to it, and a caption with the layers on screen.

controls.label: Include Lock-On Target
controls.description: Also breaks down the enemy you are locked on to when the take starts.

controls.label: This Take
controls.description: What the breakdown track will do.

sections.title: Look
sections.description: Palette and outfit changes during the take, through Custom Shell System. Your own look comes back after it.

controls.label: Look Track
controls.description: Cycle palettes: every palette of the worn outfit in turn, then your own look. From the preset: look steps written in a preset file; the shipped presets have none.

controls.label: This Take
controls.description: What the look track will do.
